title: GE4u Daily Practice: Medical English
objective: Review three core terms and practise one knowledge check in Medical English.

vocabulary.definition: A change in health noticed by a patient.
Identification of a disease or condition.
Information about past and current health.
vocabulary.example: The clinician reviewed the medical history.

quiz.question: Which term is defined as: A change in health noticed by a patient.
quiz.explanation: symptom means A change in health noticed by a patient.
